lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Convoy runs the ridge every eight days. Four crates, two vehicles, four guards. Same eight days for six years, which tells you how worried they are about us.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Nobody's stopped one. Not because it can't be done — because stopping one needs four people who can stand up at the same time, and I haven't had four in a while. You've got four.

choices.text: Stopping it gets this camp burned.
